findings.evidence: `rg -n "HasCauchyPV\.(zero|const_mul|add|sum)|CauchyPVExists\.(zero|const_mul|add|sum)" code/TauCeti/Analysis/Contour/CauchyPrincipalValueOn.lean` finds only `HasCauchyPV.zero` at 178, `HasCauchyPV.const_mul` at 187, `CauchyPVExists.zero` at 225, and `CauchyPVExists.const_mul` at 230; the pointwise companion has `HasCauchyPVAt.add`/`sum` at `CauchyPrincipalValue.lean:199`/`:234`, and the roadmap target has a finite residue sum in `roadmap/TauCetiRoadmap/ContourIntegration/Suggested.lean:227`.
findings.fix: Add `HasCauchyPV.add`/`HasCauchyPV.sum` and existence forms, with any necessary `γ` regularity hypotheses and enlargement-integrability lemma exposed as part of that API.
findings.issue: `HasCauchyPV.const_mul` exposes only the scalar half of the linearity API; there is no set-level `HasCauchyPV.add`/`HasCauchyPV.sum` or corresponding `CauchyPVExists` forms, so consumers cannot combine finite principal-value summands without reproving excision-set reconciliation.

summary: The value/uniqueness API is now present, but the public operation API for the new set-level principal value is still incomplete for the residue-sum use case. Exposing only zero and scalar multiplication leaves downstream users without the additive/finite-sum characteristic lemmas needed to combine principal-value contributions.
